scope: Public source hashes and theorem application pins only. Raw source PDFs remain excluded.

sources.title: Philipp Naumann, Positivity of direct images with a Poincare type twist
Mihai Paun and Shigeharu Takayama, Positivity of twisted relative pluricanonical bundles and their direct images

application_scope.Naumann: Smooth families of log-canonically polarized pairs, semipositivity in total-space directions, then positive log-canonical current across the relative marking.
application_scope.Paun_Takayama: Theorem3.3.4 over a smooth projective family; singular twist semipositive, trivial multiplier ideal, locally free adjoint direct image and exact fibrewise norm identification. No direct application across a nodal fibre.
application_scope.node_extension: Separate rank-one subharmonic extension and zero-atom argument using actual metric growth bounds.
